name: Pro Integration

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - 'pro/**'
      - 'tests/pro/**'
      - 'bin/utils/pro-detector.js'
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'pro/**'
      - 'tests/pro/**'
      - 'bin/utils/pro-detector.js'
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 6 * * 1'  # Monday 6am UTC
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  integration:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    concurrency:
      group: "pro-integration-${{ github.ref }}"
      cancel-in-progress: true
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        if: ${{ secrets.PRO_PAT != '' }}
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          submodules: true
          token: ${{ secrets.PRO_PAT }}

      - name: Set up Node.js
        if: ${{ secrets.PRO_PAT != '' }}
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        if: ${{ secrets.PRO_PAT != '' }}
        run: npm ci

      - name: Run tests
        if: ${{ secrets.PRO_PAT != '' }}
        run: npm test

      - name: Publish test results
        if: ${{ secrets.PRO_PAT != '' && always() }}
        uses: EnricoMi/publish-unit-test-result-action@v2
        with:
          github_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          files: '**/test-results.xml'
